title: ROADMAP-1: QNFO.REACH #CARD-SIGNED: follow-up filed with a closing probe
body:
code-task: repo=ultrastable path=site/agentic.js
code-anchor: export const AGENT_CARD

**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** weekly product-manager pass; the roadmap item is taken by the executor when it is next in driver order
**Program:** QNFO.REACH
**Metric it should move:** readers
**Cost rule:** adds no worker, cron or paid model call.
**Done check:** grep:site/agentic.js::jwks\.json ; merged and verified live: GET https://ultrastable.io/.well-known/agent-card.json expect "signatures"
**Status:** closed

Serve A2A v1.0 with a JWS-signed agent card (key generated and stored by the Worker, public key at /.well-known/jwks.json, rotation by cron-free lazy refresh). Moves STD a2a-signed from planned to supported with a test that verifies the signature.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 157.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
